items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: last time I talked with Jack Jr., he was operating a motel.

ctx.x: Oh, they're all the same guys. I've got so many questions, I know we're never going to get to them. Did you know Jack T. Gardner in Texas? Oh, yeah, sure. Jack's son is there, yeah.
Oh, yeah? Where is he? He, he, last time I talked with Jack Jr., he was operating a motel. He plays a beautiful drum roll.
And Terry Shand, did you ever know? Oh, yeah, that's one of the old bands.
